# m.partners.benzinga.consensus_ratings

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The consensus of analyst ratings and price targets for each US stock, from Benzinga.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.partners.benzinga.consensus_ratings(symbols, *, filters=None)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | US stock tickers; required (`dm.ALL` is refused). |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | The `date` range of the ratings to aggregate (`date_gte`, `date_lt`, ...); None aggregates every rating. Keys: `date`, `date_any_of`, `date_gt`, `date_gte`, `date_lt`, `date_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Consensus Ratings (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Benzinga Analyst Ratings | Updated every 2 hours, All history |
| Benzinga Analyst Ratings Business | Updated every 2 hours, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The requested ticker." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `BuyRatings` | long | The count of 'Buy' ratings from contributing analysts. |
| `ConsensusPriceTarget` | double | The average price target across all analysts, rounded to 2 decimal places. |
| `ConsensusRating` | String | The overall rating category determined by the average consensus weight. Possible values: 'strong_buy', 'buy', 'hold', 'sell', 'strong_sell'. |
| `ConsensusRatingValue` | double | The numerical average of all consensus weights, rounded to 2 decimal places. Scale ranges from 1 (Strong Sell) to 5 (Strong Buy). |
| `HighPriceTarget` | double | The highest price target among all contributing analysts. |
| `HoldRatings` | long | The count of 'Hold' ratings from contributing analysts. |
| `LowPriceTarget` | double | The lowest price target among all contributing analysts. |
| `PriceTargetContributors` | long | The number of unique analysts contributing price targets. |
| `RatingsContributors` | long | The number of unique analysts contributing to the overall ratings consensus. |
| `SellRatings` | long | The count of 'Sell' ratings from contributing analysts. |
| `StrongBuyRatings` | long | The count of 'Strong Buy' ratings from contributing analysts. |
| `StrongSellRatings` | long | The count of 'Strong Sell' ratings from contributing analysts. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
